sop.title: Plant Propagation — Hemp Seed Germination & Tray Management
sop.title_en: Plant Propagation — Hemp Seed Germination & Tray Management
sop.title_es: Propagación de Plantas — Germinación de Semilla de Cáñamo y Manejo de Bandejas
sop.description: Standardized process for germinating hemp seed in PlantTape trays in a controlled greenhouse, through readiness for field transplanting — covering greenhouse sanitation, tray cataloging, the watering and nutrient schedule, and environmental controls. Planning constants: ~3 trays per ~1-acre zone, ~840 cells per tray (~750 usable at ~90% germination); sprouting tables hold 21 trays (7 per rung). Trays must sprout a minimum of 14 days before their scheduled field-planting date (validated, 2026 season). 2026 practice: sow extra cushion trays for replants, since a zone's 3 trays leave only ~2% spare against a 10% field-mortality model. Effective 2026-06-02 · Version 1.0 (draft).
sop.desc_en: Standardized process for germinating hemp seed in PlantTape trays in a controlled greenhouse, through readiness for field transplanting — covering greenhouse sanitation, tray cataloging, the watering and nutrient schedule, and environmental controls. Planning constants: ~3 trays per ~1-acre zone, ~840 cells per tray (~750 usable at ~90% germination); sprouting tables hold 21 trays (7 per rung). Trays must sprout a minimum of 14 days before their scheduled field-planting date (validated, 2026 season). 2026 practice: sow extra cushion trays for replants, since a zone's 3 trays leave only ~2% spare against a 10% field-mortality model. Effective 2026-06-02 · Version 1.0 (draft).
sop.desc_es: Proceso estandarizado para germinar semilla de cáñamo en bandejas PlantTape en un invernadero controlado, hasta que estén listas para el trasplante en campo — abarca la sanitización del invernadero, el catalogado de bandejas, el programa de riego y nutrientes, y los controles ambientales. Constantes de planificación: ~3 bandejas por zona de ~1 acre, ~840 celdas por bandeja (~750 utilizables al ~90% de germinación); las mesas de germinación contienen 21 bandejas (7 por nivel). Las bandejas deben germinar un mínimo de 14 días antes de su fecha programada de siembra en campo (validado, temporada 2026). Práctica 2026: sembrar bandejas adicionales de reserva para reposiciones, ya que las 3 bandejas de una zona dejan solo ~2% de excedente frente a un modelo de 10% de mortalidad en campo. Vigente 2026-06-02 · Versión 1.0 (borrador).

steps.title: Greenhouse Preparation — Weeds & Sanitation
steps.title_es: Preparación del Invernadero — Maleza y Sanitización
steps.description: Before any trays enter the greenhouse, pull all weeds from the greenhouse floor and the surrounding area, then bleach the floor and interior side walls.
steps.desc_en: Before any trays enter the greenhouse, pull all weeds from the greenhouse floor and the surrounding area, then bleach the floor and interior side walls.
steps.desc_es: Antes de que ingrese cualquier bandeja al invernadero, retire toda la maleza del piso del invernadero y del área circundante, luego aplique cloro al piso y a las paredes laterales interiores.

steps.title: Sanitize Irrigation Lines
steps.description: Flush all irrigation lines with bleach solution, follow with a hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) flush, and let the lines sit filled with H₂O₂ solution overnight before first use.
steps.desc_en: Flush all irrigation lines with bleach solution, follow with a hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) flush, and let the lines sit filled with H₂O₂ solution overnight before first use.
steps.desc_es: Enjuague todas las líneas de riego con solución de cloro, continúe con un enjuague de peróxido de hidrógeno (H₂O₂) y deje las líneas llenas con la solución de H₂O₂ durante la noche antes del primer uso.

steps.title: Catalog Incoming Trays
steps.description: Catalog every incoming PlantTape tray: record the strain, quantity, and serial code (if available).
steps.desc_en: Catalog every incoming PlantTape tray: record the strain, quantity, and serial code (if available).
steps.desc_es: Catalogue cada bandeja PlantTape entrante: registre la variedad, la cantidad y el código de serie (si está disponible).

steps.title: Lay Out & Label Trays
steps.description: Lay the trays out on the sprouting tables — 21 trays per table, 7 per rung. Label each tray with a plant tag showing serial code, strain, and date.
steps.desc_en: Lay the trays out on the sprouting tables — 21 trays per table, 7 per rung. Label each tray with a plant tag showing serial code, strain, and date.
steps.desc_es: Coloque las bandejas en las mesas de germinación — 21 bandejas por mesa, 7 por nivel. Etiquete cada bandeja con una etiqueta que indique el código de serie, la variedad y la fecha.

steps.title: Verify Dry Weight
steps.description: Confirm each tray's dry weight is in the 4.0–4.5 lb target range before saturation.
steps.desc_en: Confirm each tray's dry weight is in the 4.0–4.5 lb target range before saturation.
steps.desc_es: Confirme que el peso en seco de cada bandeja esté en el rango objetivo de 4.0–4.5 lb antes de la saturación.

steps.title: Initial Watering & Saturation
steps.description: Wet the trays using the emitter lines or a garden hose, saturating until they reach a wet weight of 14–15 lb. Each full table takes approximately 50 gallons of water.
steps.desc_en: Wet the trays using the emitter lines or a garden hose, saturating until they reach a wet weight of 14–15 lb. Each full table takes approximately 50 gallons of water.
steps.desc_es: Humedezca las bandejas usando las líneas de goteo o una manguera, saturando hasta que alcancen un peso húmedo de 14–15 lb. Cada mesa completa requiere aproximadamente 50 galones de agua.

steps.title: Germination & Timing
steps.description: Germination typically completes in about 5 days. Trays must be sprouted a minimum of 14 days before their scheduled field-planting date — confirmed as the 2026 planning standard.
steps.desc_en: Germination typically completes in about 5 days. Trays must be sprouted a minimum of 14 days before their scheduled field-planting date — confirmed as the 2026 planning standard.
steps.desc_es: La germinación normalmente se completa en aproximadamente 5 días. Las bandejas deben germinar un mínimo de 14 días antes de su fecha programada de siembra en campo — confirmado como el estándar de planificación 2026.

steps.title: Weight-Based Re-Watering
steps.description: Check tray weights frequently throughout the day. Pre-sprout (days 1–4): re-water when a tray drops to 12 lb. Post-sprout (day 4–5 onward): re-water when it drops to 7 lb. Target wet weight is 14–15 lb at both stages.
steps.desc_en: Check tray weights frequently throughout the day. Pre-sprout (days 1–4): re-water when a tray drops to 12 lb. Post-sprout (day 4–5 onward): re-water when it drops to 7 lb. Target wet weight is 14–15 lb at both stages.
steps.desc_es: Revise el peso de las bandejas con frecuencia durante el día. Antes de brotar (días 1–4): vuelva a regar cuando una bandeja baje a 12 lb. Después de brotar (día 4–5 en adelante): vuelva a regar cuando baje a 7 lb. El peso húmedo objetivo es 14–15 lb en ambas etapas.

steps.title: Nutrient Rotation (3-Watering Cycle)
steps.description: Rotate three waterings: (1) full nutrient feed — SuperThrive/B1 at ¼ tsp/gal, kelp extract at 1 tsp/gal, and liquid mycorrhizae at ¼ tsp/gal; (2) pure-water flush; (3) biological feed — kelp, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens (per label), and mycorrhizae. Repeat the cycle until trays are fully sprouted and ready to transplant.
steps.desc_en: Rotate three waterings: (1) full nutrient feed — SuperThrive/B1 at ¼ tsp/gal, kelp extract at 1 tsp/gal, and liquid mycorrhizae at ¼ tsp/gal; (2) pure-water flush; (3) biological feed — kelp, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens (per label), and mycorrhizae. Repeat the cycle until trays are fully sprouted and ready to transplant.
steps.desc_es: Rote tres riegos: (1) alimentación completa de nutrientes — SuperThrive/B1 a ¼ cdta/gal, extracto de algas a 1 cdta/gal y micorrizas líquidas a ¼ cdta/gal; (2) enjuague con agua pura; (3) alimentación biológica — algas, Bacillus amyloliquefaciens (según la etiqueta) y micorrizas. Repita el ciclo hasta que las bandejas estén completamente germinadas y listas para trasplantar.

steps.title: Prevent Overfeeding
steps.description: If watering more than once per day, make the 2nd or 3rd watering a plain-water flush to prevent overfeeding.
steps.desc_en: If watering more than once per day, make the 2nd or 3rd watering a plain-water flush to prevent overfeeding.
steps.desc_es: Si riega más de una vez al día, haga que el 2.º o 3.º riego sea un enjuague con agua pura para prevenir la sobrealimentación.

steps.title: Temperature Control
steps.description: Maintain an optimal greenhouse temperature of 75–85°F during daytime hours.
steps.desc_en: Maintain an optimal greenhouse temperature of 75–85°F during daytime hours.
steps.desc_es: Mantenga una temperatura óptima del invernadero de 75–85°F durante las horas del día.

steps.title: Nighttime Controls
steps.description: Set nighttime controls by the forecast low: at 55°F or below, close the greenhouse sides and turn heaters ON; at 56–59°F, close the sides; at 60°F or above, close the sides but keep doors open for airflow. Always check the weather forecast before end of day.
steps.desc_en: Set nighttime controls by the forecast low: at 55°F or below, close the greenhouse sides and turn heaters ON; at 56–59°F, close the sides; at 60°F or above, close the sides but keep doors open for airflow. Always check the weather forecast before end of day.
steps.desc_es: Configure los controles nocturnos según la temperatura mínima pronosticada: a 55°F o menos, cierre los laterales del invernadero y encienda los calentadores; a 56–59°F, cierre los laterales; a 60°F o más, cierre los laterales pero deje las puertas abiertas para la circulación de aire. Siempre revise el pronóstico del clima antes de terminar el día.

steps.title: Ventilation
steps.description: Run the exhaust fans ON during daytime hours and OFF at night.
steps.desc_en: Run the exhaust fans ON during daytime hours and OFF at night.
steps.desc_es: Mantenga los ventiladores de extracción ENCENDIDOS durante el día y APAGADOS por la noche.

steps.title: End-of-Day Procedures
steps.description: Clean the nutrient mixing tank; empty and flush all irrigation lines; set the sides, doors, heaters, and fans per the nighttime weather protocol; and log all tray weights, watering times, and observations in the tracking notebook.
steps.desc_en: Clean the nutrient mixing tank; empty and flush all irrigation lines; set the sides, doors, heaters, and fans per the nighttime weather protocol; and log all tray weights, watering times, and observations in the tracking notebook.
steps.desc_es: Limpie el tanque de mezcla de nutrientes; vacíe y enjuague todas las líneas de riego; ajuste los laterales, las puertas, los calentadores y los ventiladores según el protocolo climático nocturno; y registre todos los pesos de las bandejas, los horarios de riego y las observaciones en el cuaderno de seguimiento.
